title: MUniverse Grison et al 2025
description: High-density surface EMG (HDsEMG) recordings from the right tibialis anterior of one healthy participant performing submaximal isometric ankle dorsiflexions at 10 to 70 percent of maximal voluntary contraction. Signals were acquired with two 64-electrode arrays (128 electrodes total), together with force recordings. The dataset also includes labeled motor unit spike trains derived from concurrent invasive EMG, and supports motor unit decomposition research.
methods_description: The participant performed trapezoidal isometric ankle dorsiflexion contractions at 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 50, 60 and 70 percent MVC, in randomized order, with 120 s rest between contractions and ramps at 5 percent per second. HDsEMG was recorded from the right tibialis anterior with two 64-electrode arrays (4 mm interelectrode distance, 13x5 configuration), and force was recorded with a load cell in series with a dynamometer pedal. Labeled motor unit spike trains were derived from concurrent invasive EMG and curated by an experienced investigator.
